thread:
Mina K.: Heads up — zh->en eval token counts spiked after yesterday's preprocess change. BLEU down ~3.8 pts on newsdev set.
Cheng Li: Saw it too. Avg source tokens went from ~54 -> ~78 on the eval shard. Suspect lang-id heuristic flipped for mixed CJK+Latin sequences.
Mina K.: We enabled lang_detect=true in preprocess (commit 8f3a2b9) to help translit detection. Didn't expect token inflation like this.
Samir P.: Can you paste a minimal example that reproduces the split?
Cheng Li: Sure — raw input: `2025年Q1 results: revenue $5M — see chart.`
Cheng Li: Tokenized (with lang_detect=true):
```
["2025", "年", "Q", "1", "results", ":", "revenue", "$", "5", "M", "—", "see", "chart", "."] (count=14)
```
Cheng Li: Tokenized (baseline/lang_detect=false):
```
["2025年", "Q1", "results", ":", "revenue", "$5M", "—", "see", "chart."] (count=9)
```
Luca V.: Interesting — langid step is inserting boundaries between Han and Latin/numerics, which ends up increasing subword splits. Could be the lang hint pushing sentencepiece to break tokens.
Mina K.: Quick stat: ran a small sweep over 2k zh-en pairs, avg source tokens baseline=56, with langid=78. BLEU dropped from 32.1 -> 28.3 on the same subset.
eval-bot: Alert: regression detected on zh-en-newsdev (tokens per source +39%, BLEU -3.8). Affected traffic: canary region.
Samir P.: Actionable: revert lang_detect on canary ASAP, gate behind feature flag. I'll open a PR to toggle default to false and add telemetry.
Cheng Li: I'll bisect the preprocess commits between 8f3a2b9..8f3a2ff to see the exact heuristic change. Also going to dump sentencepiece merges to check vocab interactions.
Mina K.: I'll run the quantized (int8) smoke tests — want to confirm quantization doesn't make the downstream model sensitivity worse given longer token sequences.
Luca V.: Plan: 1) revert flag on canary (Samir), 2) Cheng bisects and posts a minimal repro, 3) Mina runs quant smoke and fulleval diff, 4) I will update dashboards to show token-per-source distribution and per-model BLEU delta.
Samir P.: Quick repro command for infra: `./run_eval.sh --model=veridian-v2 --tokenizer=spm-v2 --preproc-langid=false --evalset=newsdev-zh-en --out=runA.json`
Cheng Li: If anyone needs the failing sample batch, I uploaded a gz to s3: s3://redwood-evals/repro/langid-inflation/2025-samples.gz
Mina K.: I'll post results in this thread when the quant smoke finishes (~30m). Thanks all for fast triage.
Luca V.: :thumbsup: also adding a followup to the runbook about language-hinting side effects on CJK+Latin mixes.
Mina K.: assigning: Samir -> PR, Cheng -> bisect + repro, Mina -> quant smoke + fulleval, Luca -> dashboard + runbook.
Samir P.: On it.
Cheng Li: starting bisect now.
